text_blocks.snippet: U.S. visa requirements vary based on your country of citizenship. Some countries participate in the Visa Waiver Program, allowing citizens to enter the U.S. for tourism or business for up to 90 days without a visa. For those not eligible for the VWP, a nonimmigrant or immigrant visa is required, depending on the purpose and length of stay.
